descriptionChirho: General term for owned property, possessions, or accumulated wealth, whether inherited, acquired, or held as an estate — the core meaning of rĕkush covering livestock, land, and all material assets.

Movable goods, belongings, or spoil acquired through travel, migration, or conquest — distinguished in Arabic by ghanīma (spoil/booty) and amtiʿa (goods/chattels) rather than the general amwāl (wealth), and in English/Spanish by 'goods/bienes' rather than 'property/posesión'.
